name: Ritz Carlton Atlanta
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton, Atlanta: a downtown Atlanta hotel with a contemporary Southern luxury style
best_for: Business travelers during the week and families on the weekends
Guests who want a downtown base with special access to the Georgia Aquarium

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Atlanta and describes its style as contemporary Southern luxury.
AG, Modern Bar and Steakhouse has leather-clad booths lined with vintage photographs and an al fresco Veranda.
AG offers three private dining spaces.
Lumen Lounge offers live entertainment on select evenings alongside mixology and globally inspired cuisine.
Wellness Level guestrooms have PURE air purification.
The fitness center has TechnoGym equipment and Peloton bikes with live-streaming classes.
The hotel runs a Ritz Kids program for young guests.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the guests as business travelers during the week and families on the weekends.

highlights.text: The hotel is an exclusive hotel partner of the Georgia Aquarium, and guests enjoy special access to it.
The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge is on the 24th floor.
The Club Lounge hosts guided bourbon tastings.
In-Room Camping includes a premium tent, a plush sleeping bag, a flashlight, a book and a stuffed animal.
AG has a table called the Hideout, set in a secluded corner with a privacy curtain and a leather booth.

considerations.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.
The hotel does not provide shuttle service.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The Ritz-Carlton, Atlanta
